notes: Two independent pure public-API Annex C.3 composition scenarios use adapter-owned, schema-valid DIF modules. The enumerated scenario first accepts two modules that contribute disjoint enumerator names/values to one named enumerated data type, then rejects a separate pair assigning one value to two different enumerator names; a valid retry reuses the federation name. The HLAvariantRecord scenario keeps the same valid enumerated discriminant but changes the set of alternatives on one named HLAvariantRecord, which uses the non-extendable encoding; each module creates alone and the combined pair raises InconsistentFOM. This negative branch directly witnesses the no-added-alternatives rule in IEEE 1516.2-2025 §4.14.8; the separate HLAextendableVariantRecord merge scenario witnesses permitted disjoint additions. Focused installed-package CTest evidence is recorded in the scenario catalog. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR but Java provider runtime is unverified. The enumerated acceptance is bounded to disjoint module contributions; HLAboolean presence across arbitrary FOM/SOM/MIM documents, other merge branches, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
